name: Cloud 66

evidence.panel: 03: hosted management plane that runs apps on servers the customer rents; paid, not free self-hosted software
evidence.static: 03: Cloud 66 Sites deploys static sites to object storage with a CDN

line: Deploy and manage apps on your own cloud servers.

free.text: Free personal plan: 1 server, 1 site, 5 deploys/day, 50 build min

cells.selfhost: Yes; deploy to your servers or providers

work.math: A $276 a year Developer plan ($23 a month equivalent). Storage and domain costs from your server provider are not included in this total.
A $276 a year Developer fee ($23 a month equivalent), plus the server provider's VM, IP address, storage and 100 GB of data sent out. The provider and region are not specified.
A $276 a year Developer fee ($23 a month equivalent), plus two servers, storage, traffic and $0.38 per GB a month of retained backups.
